description: This file defines classes and functionality for managing and rendering prompt templates following Google's Dotprompt specification. It includes classes for handling prompt metadata, loading prompts from files and JSON data, rendering templates with Jinja2, and validating input schemas.

classes.name: PromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a single prompt template with associated metadata, content, and identifiers.

classes.name: PromptManager
classes.description: Handles loading, parsing, rendering, and management of prompt templates, supporting frontmatter YAML metadata and Jinja2 templating.

methods.description: Loads all prompt files with .prompt extension from a specified directory.

methods.description: Reads and parses a single .prompt file, extracting frontmatter and content.

methods.description: Extracts and parses YAML frontmatter from prompt content.

methods.description: Renders a prompt template with given variables, using Jinja2.
